name: Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park and Hin Nam No National Park
countries: Viet Nam, Lao People's Democratic Republic
description: Straddling the Vietnam–Laos border, this limestone wilderness is Asia's oldest large karst system, with origins about 400 million years ago. Above ground you find sheer cliffs, sinkholes and forested ridges. Below lie more than 220 kilometres of caves and underground rivers, including Sơn Đoòng, considered the world's largest cave, which was only explored in 2009.
